_comment: Greppable fact sheet for the pinned SG13G2 PDK. The enforced pin is pdk-artifact.json (per-file sha256, checked by tools/verify_pdk.py before any simulator starts). Same release as the sibling canaries sg13g2-lna sim/pdk.json and sg13g2-sat-rx sim/pdk-artifact.json.
pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2 (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention)

install_marker.note: Provenance only; hashes in pdk-artifact.json decide.

devices_used_so_far.npn13G2: native ngspice VBIC (level=9) subckt in sg13g2_hbt_mod.lib, loaded through cornerHBT.lib sections; no OSDI. Used only by sim/smoke-hbt/.
